title: Coinduced discrete modules are acyclic for continuous cochains
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite group, $A$ a finite ring, and $M$ a left $A$-module with a continuous $A$-linear $G$-action when $M$ has the discrete topology [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian]. Let $D(M)=\operatorname{Cont}(G,M)$ carry the discrete topology and the action $(h\cdot f)(x)=f(xh)$; it is a discrete continuous $G$-module [lem-exc-coinduced-discrete-embedding]. Form the inhomogeneous complex $C^n(G,D(M))=\operatorname{Cont}(G^n,D(M))$ with $d^0v(g)=g v-v$ and $d^nF(g_1,\ldots,g_{n+1})=g_1F(g_2,\ldots,g_{n+1})+\sum_{j=1}^n(-1)^jF(g_1,\ldots,g_jg_{j+1},\ldots,g_{n+1})+(-1)^{n+1}F(g_1,\ldots,g_n)$ for $n\geq1$. Then $H^q(C^\bullet(G,D(M)))=0$ for every $q>0$.
